items.label: C1
items.promptEn:
(so / is / Yuri / upset / why)
I wonder ________ with you.
accept: I wonder why Yuri is so upset with you.

items.sectionInstructionKo: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요. POINT 8-9. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.label: C2
items.promptEn:
(the event / starts / when)
I don't know ________.
accept: I don't know when the event starts.
I do not know when the event starts.

items.promptEn:

Do you know ________?
accept: Do you know what they are doing now?

items.promptEn:
